IC1: - Prior [OR] or ongoing harmful alcohol intake defined as an average of ≥24g alcohol/day for women and ≥36g/d for men for ≥ 5 year.
IC2: - Outpatients [AND] with compensated advanced chronic alcohol-related liver disease, defined as stable patients with:
IC3: 1. liver stiffness ≥15 kPa [AND] and asymptomatic [OR] and/or
IC4: 2. New liver biopsy (<6months) [AND] with at least F3 fibrosis [OR] (kleiner) and/or
IC5: 3. Liver biopsy older that 6 months [AND] with liver stiffness ≥10 kPa
IC6: - Understand and speak Danish written and orally
